description: AI end-to-end testing from the terminal, CI and coding agents: kadeep test, kadeep a11y, the MCP server and releasegate.
rules: Run `npx -y kadeep test <url> "<user journey>" --json` after UI changes and read verdict, bugs, console and network.
Exit codes: 0 pass, 1 fail, 2 usage or no model, 3 unreachable, 4 no verdict.
Without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, run `npx -y kadeep try` for a free anonymous trial.
